prompt.v: A rectangle is 1 ft by 2 ft. What is its area in square inches?

problems.text: area: 1 ft by 2 ft to in2
problems.explain: Change each side first: 1 ft = 12 inches and 2 ft = 24 inches. Then the area: 12 × 24 = 288 in². Or: 2 ft² × 144 = 288 in², since 1 ft² = 12 × 12 = 144 in². (Multiplying the area by 12 once scales only one side.) So 288 in².

problems.explain: Change each side first: 9 yd = 27 ft and 2 yd = 6 ft. Then the area: 27 × 6 = 162 ft². Or: 18 yd² × 9 = 162 ft², since 1 yd² = 3 × 3 = 9 ft². (Multiplying the area by 3 once scales only one side.) So 162 ft².
